company.name: Axle Health
company.shortDescription: Scheduling and workforce management software for home health care providers
company.description: Axle Health provides scheduling and workforce management software for home health care providers. The Axle platform includes a mobile app for clinicians, an operations dashboard for office teams, proprietary logistics algorithms to optimize scheduling, and a patient engagement and booking solution. Axle is integrated with a wide range of EMRs, and the entire Axle product can be customized and accessed modularly via API. Some of the biggest home health care providers in the country use Axle’s software to improve the utilization of their clinical teams, and automate the operational burden of scheduling and dispatching.

aiResearchSummary.text: Axle Health is developing healthcare resource management systems, as described in the title Healthcare resource management and its abstract on devices, apparatuses, systems, methods, and non transitory storage media for managing healthcare resources. These efforts align with scheduling and workforce management software for home health care providers, focusing on allocating and coordinating clinical staff, optimizing resource utilization, and managing operational workflows in healthcare delivery.
